title: Video Podcast & Executive Series
description: Turnkey multi-camera video podcast production filmed right in your boardroom, delivering full episodes and high-impact vertical clips for LinkedIn.
seoTitle: Video Podcast Production Studio | Cambridge & London
seoDescription: Multi-camera video podcast and vodcast production filmed in your Cambridge or London office. Full YouTube episodes and vertical clips built for LinkedIn reach.
heroHeading: Build continuous market authority from *your own boardroom.*
heroLead: Senior executives rarely have time to travel across town to an external recording studio. We bring broadcast cameras, studio lighting, and vocal microphones directly to your office—recording engaging conversations in half a day, and delivering weekly video content for your audience across LinkedIn, YouTube, and Spotify.
breakdownBody: We turn your meeting room into an executive recording space within minutes. Our low-profile crews set up multiple camera angles, manage sound levels, and guide discussions so leadership looks composed, sounds natural, and stays focused entirely on the conversation.

deliverables.title: Full-Length Multi-Camera Episodes
deliverables.description: Dynamic narrative cuts with smooth multi-angle switching, branded lower-thirds, and balanced audio mastering, formatted ready for YouTube, Spotify Video, and your website resource hub.

deliverables.title: Vertical LinkedIn Hook Cutdowns
deliverables.description: Fast-turnaround vertical 9:16 clips with styled on-screen captions and engaging hooks, cut specifically to drive organic engagement and comments across executive LinkedIn feeds.

deliverables.title: Mastered Audio Feeds for RSS
deliverables.description: Clean vocal audio tracks with background ambient noise removed and loudness mastered to industry broadcast standards, ready for instant RSS publishing to Apple Podcasts and Spotify.
